info.title: OmniSight API
info.summary: Executable API contract derived from the OmniSight documentation set.
info.description: All business outcomes use HTTP 200 with the envelope {ok, code, message, data, meta, errors}. HTTP 403 is never returned. Handled application errors never return HTTP 5xx; only /internal/healthz reports a real 503. Authorization and scope are enforced by the server on every request. x-permission, x-scope, x-approval, x-idempotent, and x-audit are normative metadata. Error codes are defined in kode-error.json; messages are localized to en and id.

cookieAuth.name: osc_session
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax session cookie. Cookie name is finalized in WP-03.

internalServiceToken.description: Short-lived internal service token; mTLS is required in addition.

AreaId.name: X-Area-Id
AreaId.description: Active area. Validated as a descendant of the user's scope.

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: Required for external actions. Reusing a key with a different body returns AA00-00-0007.

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description: Supported values: en (default), id. Falls back to the user locale, company locale, then en.

Envelope.description: Business response. HTTP 200 is used for success, validation, authorization denial, out-of-scope resources, conflicts, rate limits, and handled internal errors.

BinaryOrEnvelope.description: Binary download on success, or a JSON envelope on failure. Both use HTTP 200.

code.description: Stable error or success code. Never localized.

data.description: Payload, list page, or null on failure.

code.description: Stable field error code from kode-error.json.

notes: Documentation 0.6 and this contract were approved at G0 on 2026-10-30.
DTO details not listed here follow the module documentation and are added with each WP.
No operation returns HTTP 403 or an application HTTP 5xx.
